name: Synoikia
summary: Athena's feast of the synoecism — the day Athens kept for Theseus' uniting of the Attic demes into one city, with sacrifice on the Acropolis early in the civic year.
testimonia: Thucydides 2.15.1–2 (Theseus synoecises Attica; the Synoikia still kept)
Plutarch, Theseus 24.1–4 (the synoecism and the festival)
